draft.title: How exactly does llama.cpp HTTP server's file upload affect prompt handling and answer consistency?
draft.body: A user running llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_S reported inconsistent results when using the HTTP server's file upload button to ask questions about a file's contents. Sometimes the model answered the query correctly, but other times it seemed to respond as if interpreting the file content itself rather than the user's question. There's speculation that the file upload might concatenate the file content with the prompt, but this isn't confirmed. Given this, how does the file upload feature actually interact with the prompt behind the scenes? Also, what strategies or settings might help achieve reproducible answers when querying uploaded files, so that repeated prompts yield consistent responses across new conversations?
